dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you found any good projects?

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Projects... Haeh. Honestly, I haven't found anything worthwhile that we can get underway quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Of the ones I've examined, the best have, at most, "relatively optimistic future prospects."

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: But what can we do? After all, all the valuable projects were personally destroyed by Mr. Edwin Eastinghouse.
